model.title: A resolution recognizing and supporting the goals and ideals of National Forensic Science Week.

summary.text: The resolution aims to recognize and support National Forensic Science Week, celebrating the importance of forensic science and the professionals who use scientific methods to solve crimes and support the justice system.
